title: Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program Replacement Packages and Carrier Proof of Delivery
content:
A replacement on the Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program ships at no charge, draws no authorized units and is never billed to a payer; it is recorded against the original shipment it replaces, and its quantity never exceeds the units of that original shipment that were lost, damaged, not received or defective.

## Standard by cause of replacement

**Lost in transit.** A package is lost in transit when no proof of delivery is on file for it and the tier's carrier trace period in business days (Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays) has passed after the carrier's expected delivery date. A package lost in transit is always replaced, expedited at no charge, and does not count toward any courtesy limit, because Larkfield bears the risk until delivery.

**Damaged in transit.** A package damaged in transit is replaced when the customer reports the damage no later than the tier's damage report window in calendar days after the delivery date on the proof of delivery for that package, counted in calendar days from that delivery date with the last day allowed; a later damage report is not replaced.

**Delivered but not received.** A package the proof of delivery shows as delivered but the customer reports not received is replaced as a courtesy only while the program's courtesy reships over the rolling 12 months ending on the reship date are fewer than the tier's courtesy reship allowance; beyond that the customer may buy the item at the cash price or wait for the next eligible refill. The courtesy reships counted are the program's replacement shipments recorded with the reason delivered but not received whose ship date falls in the 365 calendar days ending on and including the reship date being considered.

**Temperature excursion.** Insulin that arrives warm — its cold packs fully thawed, or the package delivered more than the tier's cold-chain validation hours after it shipped — is a temperature excursion: the customer must not use it, it is not sent back, and it is replaced at no charge, shipped expedited at no charge, when the customer reports it no later than the damage report window in calendar days after the delivery date.

**Product defect.** A pen or vial that was defective as shipped — cracked, the wrong product or strength, expired or from a recalled lot — is replaced as a product defect when reported no later than the tier's defect report window in calendar days after the delivery date.

## Proof of delivery

A proof of delivery is recorded as received from the carrier, with a signature where the tier or item requires a signature on delivery, and it fixes the delivery date that return, damage and warranty windows count from; a package without a proof of delivery has no delivery date.

## Cases worked through (hypothetical figures)

| Situation | Judgement |
|---|---|
| Proof of delivery dated 2026-04-06; damage window of 2 days; damage reported 2026-04-08 | Replaced — the last day of the window is allowed |
| Same package; damage reported 2026-04-09 | Not replaced — the report is later than the window |
| Courtesy allowance of 1; no delivered-but-not-received replacement of the program shipped in the 365 days ending on the reship date | Courtesy replacement allowed (0 is fewer than 1) |
| Courtesy allowance of 1; one such replacement shipped 200 days before the reship date | No courtesy replacement; the customer may buy the item at the cash price or wait for the next eligible refill |
| No proof of delivery on file; carrier trace period has passed after the expected delivery date | Lost in transit — always replaced, expedited at no charge, not counted toward the courtesy limit |

A courtesy reship counted for the limit is one whose reason was delivered but not received; a replacement for a package lost in transit is not among them.
